# An sse route may bind a form struct with parsed (non-string) fields. A field
# parse failure responds 400 before the event stream is established.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "POST /allocations sse(CreateAllocation(ctx, form, execute))" -}}hours: {{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type AllocationForm struct {
	Person string `name:"person"`
	Hours  int    `name:"hours"`
}

type Server struct{}

func (Server) CreateAllocation(_ context.Context, f AllocationForm, execute func(data int) error) error {
	return execute(f.Hours)
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestSSEFormFieldParse(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("a bad int responds 400 before the stream starts", func(t *testing.T) {
		mux := http.NewServeMux()
		TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})
		form := url.Values{"person": []string{"sam"}, "hours": []string{"abc"}}
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/allocations", strings.NewReader(form.Encode()))
		req.Header.Set("content-type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
			t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusBadRequest)
		}
		if ct := rec.Header().Get("content-type"); strings.Contains(ct, "text/event-stream") {
			t.Errorf("content-type = %q, the stream must not be established", ct)
		}
	})
	t.Run("a good int streams the event", func(t *testing.T) {
		mux := http.NewServeMux()
		TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})
		form := url.Values{"person": []string{"sam"}, "hours": []string{"3"}}
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/allocations", strings.NewReader(form.Encode()))
		req.Header.Set("content-type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
			t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusOK)
		}
		if ct := rec.Header().Get("content-type"); !strings.Contains(ct, "text/event-stream") {
			t.Errorf("content-type = %q, want text/event-stream", ct)
		}
		if body := rec.Body.String(); !strings.Contains(body, "hours:3") {
			t.Errorf("body %q does not contain the rendered event data", body)
		}
	})
}
